menuItems.title: Margherita Classica Pizza
menuItems.description: Hand-stretched sourdough crust with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, aromatic basil leaves, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

menuItems.title: Farmhouse Gourmet Pizza
menuItems.description: Loaded with colorful bell peppers, button mushrooms, sweet golden corn, red onions, black olives, and melted mozzarella on our signature crisp crust.

menuItems.title: Paneer Tikka Supreme Pizza
menuItems.description: Charcoal-tandoori marinated paneer cubes, crisp capsicum, charred onions, and spicy red paprika topped with a fresh coriander-mint swirl.

menuItems.title: Fiery Peri-Peri Veggie Pizza
menuItems.description: Spicy African bird's eye peri-peri sauce base, crisp capsicum, grilled corn, sliced pickled jalapeños, and mozzarella with crushed red chilies.

menuItems.title: BBQ Paneer & Caramelized Onion Pizza
menuItems.description: Slow-caramelized brown onions, roasted spiced cottage cheese, smoky hickory barbecue sauce, and a blanket of mozzarella cheese.

menuItems.title: Classic Crispy Veggie Burger
menuItems.description: Golden crumb-coated potato and herb patty, crisp iceberg lettuce, ripe farm tomatoes, pickled gherkins, and secret burger sauce in a toasted brioche bun.

menuItems.title: Smoky BBQ Paneer Burger
menuItems.description: Thick slab of herb-marinated paneer grilled over open flame, topped with melted English cheddar, crunchy coleslaw, and smoky BBQ reduction.

menuItems.title: Double Cheese Jalapeño Crunch Burger
menuItems.description: Crispy spiced veggie patty stacked with double melted cheddar slices, pickled spicy jalapeños, crispy onion rings, and chipotle garlic aioli.

menuItems.title: Grilled Pesto & Mozzarella Panini
menuItems.description: Italian focaccia filled with house-made basil pesto, sun-dried tomatoes, sliced plum tomatoes, and stretchy melted mozzarella, toasted crisp.

menuItems.title: Bombay Club Grilled Sandwich
menuItems.description: Three-tiered toasted jumbo sandwich layered with cucumber ribbons, sliced tomatoes, spiced potatoes, fiery mint chutney, and molten cheese.

menuItems.title: Classic Golden Finger Chips (Fries)
menuItems.description: Crispy golden-fried potato finger chips seasoned with crushed sea salt, served piping hot with creamy garlic mayo and tomato ketchup.

menuItems.title: Peri-Peri Masala Finger Chips
menuItems.description: Extra-crunchy potato finger chips generously dusted with our zesty in-house African peri-peri seasoning and tangy lemon zest.

menuItems.title: Cheesy Loaded Finger Chips
menuItems.description: Hot crispy finger chips drowned in velvety molten cheddar cheese sauce, topped with diced pickled jalapeños and spring onions.

menuItems.title: Cheesy Garlic Breadsticks
menuItems.description: Freshly baked artisan herb baguette slathered in roasted garlic herb butter and crowned with gooey, pull-apart mozzarella.

menuItems.title: Crispy Mozzarella Cheese Sticks
menuItems.description: Italian herb crumb-crusted mozzarella batons fried to a crisp golden crunch with an oozing cheesy center. Served with spiced marinara dip.

menuItems.title: Crispy Nachos Grande with Cheese & Salsa
menuItems.description: Stone-ground corn tortilla chips accompanied by fresh tomato-cilantro salsa, warm jalapeño cheese sauce, and sour cream.

menuItems.title: Belgian Dark Chocolate Fudge Sundae
menuItems.description: Two generous scoops of 70% dark Belgian chocolate ice cream, warm fudge brownie crumble, hot chocolate fudge sauce, and roasted almond slivers.

menuItems.title: Alphonso Mango Swirl Ice Cream
menuItems.description: Made from Ratnagiri Alphonso mango pulp, churned into silky cream with real candied mango chunks and passionfruit drizzle.

menuItems.title: Classic American Banana Split
menuItems.description: Fresh ripe banana split in two, cradling trio scoops of vanilla bean, rich chocolate, and strawberry gelato, finished with whipped cream and maraschino cherry.

menuItems.title: Death by Chocolate (DBC) Sundae
menuItems.description: Layers of gooey chocolate cake, chocolate mousse, Dutch chocolate gelato, vanilla bean scoop, hot fudge syrup, topped with toasted cashew nuts and cherries.

menuItems.title: Wild Strawberry Swirl Waffle Sundae
menuItems.description: Crisp golden Belgian waffle topped with strawberry cream gelato, wild berry compote, white chocolate drizzle, and fresh mint leaf.

menuItems.title: Classic Cold Coffee with Ice Cream
menuItems.description: Double shot of fresh Arabica espresso blended thick with whole chilled milk, crowned with a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream and cocoa dusting.

menuItems.title: Thick Nutella Hazelnut Shake
menuItems.description: Decadent Nutella blended with rich chocolate gelato, whole milk, toasted crushed hazelnuts, and a swirl of whipped cream.

menuItems.title: Iced Caramel Macchiato
menuItems.description: Chilled milk infused with Madagascar vanilla syrup, marked with bold espresso shots over ice, and drizzled with buttery golden caramel sauce.

menuItems.title: Fresh Virgin Mint Mojito
menuItems.description: Hand-muddled fresh garden mint leaves and juicy key lime wedges shaken with organic cane sugar, crushed ice, and effervescent sparkling soda.

menuItems.title: Belgian Chocolate Thickshake
menuItems.description: Rich Dutch cocoa melted into thick dairy cream, blended until spoon-thick, and garnished with dark chocolate curls.

reviews.title: A religious culinary experience!
reviews.comment: The Ghee Pudi Masala Dosa is crisp perfection. Unbelievable aroma of Nandini ghee, and the degree filter coffee in brass dabara took me straight to heaven.
reviews.reply: Thank you Priya! Our café is our temple and serving you is our divine joy. Can't wait to see you again soon!

reviews.title: Best South Indian breakfast in North Karnataka
reviews.comment: Softest thatte idlis I have ever had. The standing adda format is so lively and energetic. Staff served us within 4 minutes flat!
reviews.reply: Heartfelt gratitude Vikram Sir! Lightning speed and pure cow ghee are our promises.

reviews.title: Superb food, bit crowded at 8 PM peak
reviews.comment: Pani puri tasting flight was super creative with 4 distinct waters. Waiting line was 15 mins during peak dinner rush, but totally worth it.
reviews.reply: Thank you Rahul! We are expanding our garden patio seating at Jamakhandi next month to reduce wait times during peak hours.

reviews.title: Chai was slightly sweet for my taste
reviews.comment: Ordered masala chai, wanted it without sugar but got regular. The papdi chaat made up for it though!
reviews.reply: Our apologies Kiran. We have briefed our barista counter to strictly follow custom sweetness tags on KOT tickets. Your next coffee is on us!
